g.text: «one per open WebSocket, replaces the old bare connectionBBox map»
positionBBox is unchanged from before CP3 --
once from user_workspaces at connection open,
for role == operator only. Demo never
from positionBBox instead, at delivery time.
Nothing about matchesScope changed for CP3.
The only new code is what builds a ScopeFilter
and when -- once per connection for an operator,
freshly from positionBBox on every alert for demo.
